description: Deep verification report for one service in the Agent Data Core store: its verification state and evidence, health, delivery proof, demand, scorecard, endpoint counts, and record-level sources, verbatim from the store. An unknown service id is answered free, before payment. $0.05 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/datacore/report.

service_id.description: The service id (toll prefix slug) to report on.
